recommendation: Keep the commit as the source fix for FHIR-20170. If FM later wants the optional PHR-S FM link from the issue description, handle that as a separate work-group/editorial decision because it was not part of the final resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-20170 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It reported that the Claim Boundaries and Relationships section used patient health Record (PHR) and resolved to change all uses of patient health record to personal health record; the originally suggested external PHR-S FM link was not included in the final resolution.
initial_application: No current history commit directly mentioned FHIR-20170. Pickaxe history found b2471a772c66738faa9af1edb98176d0cd5e8055 partially changed the main Claim paragraph to Personal Health Record, but Claim's table and parallel eClaim introduction/table text in ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, CoverageEligibilityResponse, and PaymentReconciliation still retained stale Patient/patient health Record wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Claim, ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, CoverageEligibilityResponse, and PaymentReconciliation as active resources in the Financial Management work group and patient compartment. Community/context searches found no conflicting decision: Jira FTS found only FHIR-20170 for the exact terminology request, Confluence had no FHIR-20170 references, and a Zulip EOB.created thread only quoted the stale wording while discussing EOB.created semantics.
reconciliation: Changed the active eClaim source pages so the affected Boundaries and Relationships prose and ExplanationOfBenefit table rows consistently say Personal Health Record or Personal Health Record system. No link or broader editorial rewrite was added because the final Jira resolution only required the terminology change.
source_changes: source/claim/claim-introduction.xml: changed the ExplanationOfBenefit table row from Patient Health Record system to Personal Health Record system.
source/claimresponse/claimresponse-introduction.xml: changed the direct PHR sentence and ExplanationOfBenefit table row to Personal Health Record.
source/explanationofbenefit/explanationofbenefit-introduction.xml: changed the direct PHR sentence and table row to Personal Health Record.
source/coverageeligibilityresponse/coverageeligibilityresponse-introduction.xml: changed the direct PHR sentence and table row to Personal Health Record.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-introduction.xml: changed the direct PHR sentence and table row to Personal Health Record.
